Dawn C API Android `.so` (NativeGpu / `GpuBackends.dawn()`).

**Press pin (GAV 0.1.2+)** is Google’s dated Android static `.a`, NDK-linked:

  tag  v20260828.215121
  SHA  bddf1a04f7c262107a9aae301c45fc49e15c7fef

  python3 ./scripts/build-dawn-c-android.py --prebuilt --targets arm64-v8a x86_64
  .\scripts\build-dawn-c-android.ps1 -Prebuilt -Targets arm64-v8a,x86_64

That is the binary that was green on-device with `dawn_c.rs`. Publish packs
`out/<abi>/libwebgpu_dawn.so` into the `host-dawn` AAR. `--build` at the
androidx leftover SHA is **not** the press path (different commit, different
`.so`; Maven `0.1.1` shipped it and black-screened).

`androidx.webgpu:webgpu:1.0.0-alpha05` leftover JNI (`libwebgpu_c_bundled.so`)
is a different Dawn SHA:

  9d41fdf36977cca92361c6ae2769129bbaaafd9b

Default APK **excludes** that leftover. NativeGpu is one C-API Dawn `.so`
(NG-7), not the androidx JNI binary.

Upstream: https://dawn.googlesource.com/dawn (GitHub mirror https://github.com/google/dawn)
License: BSD-3-Clause (see LICENSE in this directory).

Recipe (does **not** git-add any `.so`):

  python3 ./scripts/build-dawn-c-android.py --probe-aar
  python3 ./scripts/build-dawn-c-android.py --prebuilt --targets arm64-v8a x86_64
  python3 ./scripts/build-dawn-c-android.py --build --targets arm64-v8a x86_64

`--probe-aar` downloads the published AAR into `.cache/` (gitignored) and
records JNI leftover size + missing `webgpu.h` exports.
`--prebuilt` needs NDK `28.2.13676358` (clang link of the Google `.a`).
`--build` is a local experiment (CMake at `DAWN_COMMIT` / androidx SHA);
do not press it unless that pair of `.so` files is green on the same device.

Cloud CI assemble without the recipe stays table-backed.

Do not git-add `libwebgpu_c_bundled.so` (already inside androidx.webgpu).
Do not ship androidx bundled + this C API `.so` together in the default APK.
